extracted.name: Banana Breakfast Cookies
extracted.description: This easy banana variation on breakfast cookies makes a great alternative to pricey store-bought granola bars!
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Mash bananas in a large bowl. Add oats, raisins, yogurt, and cinnamon. Mix well and allow to sit for 15 minutes.
Drop spoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto the prepared cookie sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 20 minutes.
